passages.text: After the plague had ended, the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by the houses of their fathers—all those twenty years of age or older who can serve in the army of Israel.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Eleazar.
Eleazar was the son of Aaron the priest.
This happened after the plague ended.
The LORD gave them a command.
He said, “Count all the people of Israel.
Count every man who is twenty years old or older.
Count them by their fathers’ houses.
Count everyone who is able to serve in Israel’s army.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י הַמַּגֵּפָ֑ה פ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶ֧ל אֶלְעָזָ֛ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ שְׂא֞וּ אֶת־ רֹ֣אשׁ׀ כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued the instruction, “Take a census of the men twenty years of age or older, as the LORD has commanded Moses.” And these were the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. These were the descendants of Reuben: The Hanochite clan from Hanoch, the Palluite clan from Pallu, the Hezronite clan from Hezron, and the Carmite clan from Carmi.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest and the son of Aaron.
Moses and Eleazar spoke to the Israelites.
They were on the plains of Moab.
This place was by the Jordan River.
It was across from Jericho.
Moses and Eleazar gave an instruction.
They said, “Count all the men of Israel who are twenty years old or older.”
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
These men were from the Israelites who came out of Egypt.
Reuben was the firstborn son of Israel.
These are the descendants of Reuben.
The Hanochite clan came from Hanoch.
The Palluite clan came from Pallu.
The Hezronite clan came from Hezron.
The Carmite clan came from Carmi.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֹתָ֖ם בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃ מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֗ן חֲנוֹךְ֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַחֲנֹכִ֔י לְפַלּ֕וּא מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפַּלֻּאִֽי׃ לְחֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶצְרוֹנִ֑י לְכַרְמִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַכַּרְמִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Reuben, and their registration numbered 43,730.
passages.sermon:
Reuben was the firstborn son of Israel.
Reuben had several clans.
These clans came from his descendants.
The clans of Reuben were counted.
Their total number was 43,730.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Now the son of Pallu was Eliab, and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. It was Dathan and Abiram, chosen by the congregation, who fought against Moses and Aaron with the followers of Korah who rebelled against the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Pallu had a son named Eliab.
Eliab had three sons.
Their names were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram.
Dathan and Abiram were leaders chosen by the congregation.
Dathan and Abiram opposed Moses and Aaron.
They joined Korah’s followers in rebellion against the LORD.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י פַלּ֖וּא אֱלִיאָֽב׃ וּבְנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֔ב נְמוּאֵ֖ל וְדָתָ֣ן וַאֲבִירָ֑ם הֽוּא־ דָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם קְרוּאֵי הָעֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצּ֜וּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ בַּעֲדַת־ קֹ֔רַח בְּהַצֹּתָ֖ם עַל־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire consumed 250 men. They serve as a warning sign.
passages.sermon:
God judged Dathan, Abiram, and Korah for their rebellion.
The earth opened its mouth.
The earth swallowed Dathan, Abiram, and Korah.
Korah’s followers died at the same time.
Fire consumed 250 men who followed Korah.
These events became a warning sign to others.
passages.original: וַתִּפְתַּ֨ח הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־ פִּ֗יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֛ם וְאֶת־ קֹ֖רַח בְּמ֣וֹת הָעֵדָ֑ה בַּאֲכֹ֣ל הָאֵ֗שׁ אֵ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַיִּהְי֖וּ לְנֵֽס׃

passages.text: However, the line of Korah did not die out.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Korah did not die.
God spared the descendants of Korah.
Korah’s family continued after the rebellion.
The line of Korah survived.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי־ קֹ֖רַח לֹא־ מֵֽתוּ׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Simeon by their clans: The Nemuelite clan from Nemuel, the Jaminite clan from Jamin, the Jachinite clan from Jachin, the Zerahite clan from Zerah, and the Shaulite clan from Shaul.
passages.sermon:

One clan came from Jamin.
This clan was called the Jaminite clan.
One clan came from Jachin.
This clan was called the Jachinite clan.
One clan came from Zerah.
This clan was called the Zerahite clan.
One clan came from Shaul.

passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעוֹן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִנְמוּאֵ֗ל מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַנְּמ֣וּאֵלִ֔י לְיָמִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּמִינִ֑י לְיָכִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּכִינִֽי׃ לְזֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַזַּרְחִ֑י לְשָׁא֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁאוּלִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Simeon, and there were 22,200 men.
passages.sermon: The clans of Simeon are listed here.\r\nThese clans belong to the tribe of Simeon.\r\nThe number of men in these clans was 22,200.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֑י שְׁנַ֧יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Gad by their clans: The Zephonite clan from Zephon, the Haggite clan from Haggi, the Shunite clan from Shuni, the Oznite clan from Ozni, the Erite clan from Eri, the Arodite clan from Arod, and the Arelite clan from Areli.

This was the Haggite clan.

This was the Shunite clan.
One clan came from Ozni.
This was the Oznite clan.
One clan came from Eri.
This was the Erite clan.
One clan came from Arod.
This was the Arodite clan.
One clan came from Areli.
This was the Arelite clan.

passages.text: These were the clans of Gad, and their registration numbered 40,500.
passages.sermon:
Gad was one of the tribes of Israel.
Gad had several clans.

passages.text: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but they died in the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
Judah had two sons. 
Their names were Er and Onan. 
Er died in the land of Canaan. 
Onan also died in the land of Canaan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עֵ֣ר וְאוֹנָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מָת עֵ֛ר וְאוֹנָ֖ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: These were the descendants of Judah by their clans: The Shelanite clan from Shelah, the Perezite clan from Perez, and the Zerahite clan from Zerah.

Judah had descendants.

This clan was called the Perezite clan.
Another clan came from Zerah.

passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־ יְהוּדָה֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְשֵׁלָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַשֵּׁ֣לָנִ֔י לְפֶ֕רֶץ מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפַּרְצִ֑י לְזֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַזַּרְחִֽי׃

passages.text: And these were the descendants of Perez: the Hezronite clan from Hezron and the Hamulite clan from Hamul.

Perez had descendants.

passages.text: These were the clans of Judah, and their registration numbered 76,500.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a son of Jacob.
Judah had descendants.
These descendants formed clans.
The clans of Judah were counted.

passages.text: These were the clans of Issachar, and their registration numbered 64,300.
passages.sermon: The tribe of Issachar had several clans.\r\nThese clans belonged to Issachar.\r\nThe people counted in these clans totaled 64,300.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Zebulun by their clans: The Seredite clan from Sered, the Elonite clan from Elon, and the Jahleelite clan from Jahleel.

Zebulun became the ancestor of the tribe of Zebulun.
The tribe of Zebulun had several clans.
One clan came from Sered.
This clan was called the Seredite clan.
One clan came from Elon.
This clan was called the Elonite clan.
One clan came from Jahleel.
This clan was called the Jahleelite clan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְסֶ֗רֶד מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַסַּרְדִּ֔י לְאֵל֕וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֵלֹנִ֑י לְיַ֨חְלְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיַּחְלְאֵלִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Zebulun, and their registration numbered 60,500.
passages.sermon: The tribe of Zebulun had several clans.\r\nThe people counted each clan.\r\nThe total number of people in Zebulun’s clans was 60,500.

passages.text: The descendants of Joseph included the clans of Manasseh and Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the father of two main groups.
These groups were called clans.
The first clan was Manasseh.
The second clan was Ephraim.
These clans came from Joseph’s descendants.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶפְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: These were the descendants of Manasseh: The Machirite clan from Machir, the father of Gilead, and the Gileadite clan from Gilead.
passages.sermon:
Manasseh was a son of Joseph.
Manasseh had descendants.

Gilead had descendants.
The Gileadite clan came from Gilead.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לְמָכִיר֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמָּכִירִ֔י וּמָכִ֖יר הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ גִּלְעָ֑ד לְגִלְעָ֕ד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגִּלְעָדִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the descendants of Gilead: the Iezerite clan from Iezer, the Helekite clan from Helek, the Asrielite clan from Asriel, the Shechemite clan from Shechem, the Shemidaite clan from Shemida, and the Hepherite clan from Hepher.

The Iezerite clan came from Iezer.

The Helekite clan came from Helek.

The Asrielite clan came from Asriel.

The Shechemite clan came from Shechem.
Shemida was a son of Gilead.
The Shemidaite clan came from Shemida.

passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד אִיעֶ֕זֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאִֽיעֶזְרִ֑י לְחֵ֕לֶק מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶלְקִֽי׃ וְאַ֨שְׂרִיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽאַשְׂרִֽאֵלִ֑י וְשֶׁ֕כֶם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁכְמִֽי׃ וּשְׁמִידָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִ֑י וְחֵ֕פֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶפְרִֽי׃

passages.text: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons but only daughters. The names of his daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
passages.sermon:

Zelophehad had no sons.

passages.original: וּצְלָפְחָ֣ד בֶּן־ חֵ֗פֶר לֹא־ הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־ בָּנ֑וֹת וְשֵׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֔ד מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Manasseh, and their registration numbered 52,700.
passages.sermon:

passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י שׁוּתָ֑לַח לְעֵרָ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָעֵרָנִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Ephraim, and their registration numbered 32,500. These clans were the descendants of Joseph.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim was a son of Joseph.
Joseph was a son of Jacob.
The descendants of Ephraim formed several clans.

The total number of people in these clans was 32,500.
All these clans came from Joseph’s family.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֤ת בְּנֵי־ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לִפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־ יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Benjamin by their clans: The Belaite clan from Bela, the Ashbelite clan from Ashbel, the Ahiramite clan from Ahiram, the Shuphamite clan from Shupham, and the Huphamite clan from Hupham.

This was the Ashbelite clan.

This was the Ahiramite clan.
One clan came from Shupham.
This was the Shuphamite clan.
One clan came from Hupham.
This was the Huphamite clan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְבֶ֗לַע מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַבַּלְעִ֔י לְאַשְׁבֵּ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽאַשְׁבֵּלִ֑י לַאֲחִירָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֲחִירָמִֽי׃ לִשְׁפוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּפָמִ֑י לְחוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַחוּפָמִֽי׃

passages.text: And the descendants of Bela from Ard and Naaman were the Ardite clan from Ard and the Naamite clan from Naaman.
passages.sermon:
Bela was a descendant of Benjamin.
Bela had two sons.
Their names were Ard and Naaman.
Ard’s descendants formed the Ardite clan.
Naaman’s descendants formed the Naamite clan.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ בֶ֖לַע אַ֣רְדְּ וְנַעֲמָ֑ן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הָֽאַרְדִּ֔י לְנַֽעֲמָ֔ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽנַּעֲמִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Benjamin, and their registration numbered 45,600.
passages.sermon:
Benjamin was a son of Jacob.
Benjamin had descendants.
These descendants formed clans.
Each clan belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
People counted the members of these clans.
The total number was 45,600.
passages.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: The Shuhamite clan from Shuham. These were the clans of Dan.
passages.sermon:
Dan was a son of Israel.
Dan had descendants.
Dan’s descendants formed clans.
Shuham was a descendant of Dan.
The Shuhamite clan came from Shuham.
All the clans of Dan came from Shuham.
These were the clans of Dan.
passages.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־ דָן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לְשׁוּחָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּחָמִ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת דָּ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: All of them were Shuhamite clans, and their registration numbered 64,400.
passages.sermon: The Shuhamite clans belonged to the tribe of Dan.\r\nAll the clans of Dan were Shuhamite clans.\r\nThe total number of people in these clans was 64,400.
passages.original: כָּל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַשּׁוּחָמִ֖י לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Asher by their clans: The Imnite clan from Imnah, the Ishvite clan from Ishvi, and the Beriite clan from Beriah.
passages.sermon:
Asher was a son of Jacob.
Asher had descendants.
These descendants formed clans.
One clan came from Imnah.
This clan was called the Imnite clan.
Another clan came from Ishvi.
This clan was called the Ishvite clan.
Another clan came from Beriah.
This clan was called the Beriite clan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁר֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְיִמְנָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַיִּמְנָ֔ה לְיִשְׁוִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיִּשְׁוִ֑י לִבְרִיעָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַבְּרִיעִֽי׃

passages.text: And these were the descendants of Beriah: the Heberite clan from Heber and the Malchielite clan from Malchiel.
passages.sermon:
Beriah had descendants.
Heber was one descendant of Beriah.
The Heberite clan came from Heber.
Malchiel was another descendant of Beriah.
The Malchielite clan came from Malchiel.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה לְחֶ֕בֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶבְרִ֑י לְמַ֨לְכִּיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִֽי׃

passages.text: And the name of Asher’s daughter was Serah.
passages.sermon: Asher was a son of Jacob.\r\nAsher had a daughter.\r\nHer name was Serah.
passages.original: וְשֵׁ֥ם בַּת־ אָשֵׁ֖ר שָֽׂרַח׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Asher, and their registration numbered 53,400.
passages.sermon:
Asher was a son of Israel.
Asher had descendants.
These descendants formed clans.
The clans of Asher were counted.
Their total number was 53,400.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־ אָשֵׁ֖ר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Naphtali by their clans: The Jahzeelite clan from Jahzeel, the Gunite clan from Guni, the Jezerite clan from Jezer, and the Shillemite clan from Shillem.
passages.sermon:
Naphtali was a son of Israel.
Naphtali had descendants.
These descendants formed clans.
One clan came from Jahzeel.
This clan was called the Jahzeelite clan.
One clan came from Guni.
This clan was called the Gunite clan.
One clan came from Jezer.
This clan was called the Jezerite clan.
One clan came from Shillem.
This clan was called the Shillemite clan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֤י נַפְתָּלִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לְיַ֨חְצְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיַּחְצְאֵלִ֑י לְגוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגּוּנִֽי׃ לְיֵ֕צֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיִּצְרִ֑י לְשִׁלֵּ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the clans of Naphtali, and their registration numbered 45,400.
passages.sermon:
Naphtali was one of the tribes of Israel.
Naphtali had several clans.
These clans belonged to the descendants of Naphtali.
The people counted the members of these clans.
The total number of people in the clans of Naphtali was 45,400.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: These men of Israel numbered 601,730 in all.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
God commanded Moses to count the Israelites.
Moses counted all the men of Israel.
The total number was 601,730.
passages.original: אֵ֗לֶּה פְּקוּדֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וָאָ֑לֶף שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “The land is to be divided among the tribes as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD said, “Divide the land among the tribes of Israel.
Give the land as an inheritance.
Divide the land according to the number of names in each tribe.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ לָאֵ֗לֶּה תֵּחָלֵ֥ק הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Increase the inheritance for a large tribe and decrease it for a small one; each tribe is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those registered.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses about dividing the land among the tribes of Israel.
A large tribe will receive a larger inheritance.
A small tribe will receive a smaller inheritance.
Each tribe will receive land based on the number of people counted in that tribe.
passages.original: לָרַ֗ב תַּרְבֶּה֙ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ וְלַמְעַ֕ט תַּמְעִ֖יט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י פְקֻדָ֔יו יֻתַּ֖ן נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Indeed, the land must be divided by lot; they shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave instructions about dividing the land.
The Israelites must divide the land by casting lots.
Each tribe will receive its share by this method.
The share will match the name of each tribe of their fathers.
Each tribe will inherit according to its ancestral name.
passages.original: אַךְ־ בְּגוֹרָ֕ל יֵחָלֵ֖ק אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לִשְׁמ֥וֹת מַטּוֹת־ אֲבֹתָ֖ם יִנְחָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes.”
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to divide the land of Canaan.
God told them to use lots to divide the land.
Each tribe would receive its inheritance by lot.
This rule applied to both large and small tribes.
The size of the tribe did not change the use of lots.
Every tribe, whether many or few, received its share by this method.
passages.original: עַל־ פִּי֙ הַגּוֹרָ֔ל תֵּחָלֵ֖ק נַחֲלָת֑וֹ בֵּ֥ין רַ֖ב לִמְעָֽט׃ס

passages.text: Now these were the Levites numbered by their clans: The Gershonite clan from Gershon, the Kohathite clan from Kohath, and the Merarite clan from Merari.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Levites had different clans.
The Gershonite clan came from Gershon.
The Kohathite clan came from Kohath.
The Merarite clan came from Merari.
These are the clans of the Levites.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֣י הַלֵּוִי֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְגֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י לִקְהָ֕ת מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקְּהָתִ֑י לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמְּרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the families of the Levites: The Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Now Kohath was the father of Amram, and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She was also a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Levites had several families.
The Libnite family belonged to the Levites.
The Hebronite family belonged to the Levites.
The Mahlite family belonged to the Levites.
The Mushite family belonged to the Levites.
The Korahite family belonged to the Levites.
Kohath was a man from the Levite tribe.
Kohath became the father of Amram.
Amram’s wife was named Jochebed.
Jochebed was a daughter of Levi.
Levi was the ancestor of the Levites.
Jochebed was born to Levi in Egypt.
Jochebed gave birth to Aaron.
Jochebed gave birth to Moses.
Jochebed gave birth to Miriam, their sister.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת לֵוִ֗י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת הַלִּבְנִ֜י מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽחֶבְרֹנִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַמַּחְלִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקָּרְחִ֑י וּקְהָ֖ת הוֹלִ֥ד אֶת־ עַמְרָֽם׃ וְשֵׁ֣ם׀ אֵ֣שֶׁת עַמְרָ֗ם יוֹכֶ֙בֶד֙ בַּת־ לֵוִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֥ה אֹתָ֛הּ לְלֵוִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעַמְרָ֗ם אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת מִרְיָ֥ם אֲחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were born to Aaron, but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was a priest of Israel.
Aaron had four sons.
Their names were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Nadab and Abihu died.
They died because they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶת־ נָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־ אֲבִיה֑וּא אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־ אִיתָמָֽר׃ וַיָּ֥מָת נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִיה֑וּא בְּהַקְרִיבָ֥ם אֵשׁ־ זָרָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The registration of the Levites totaled 23,000, every male a month old or more; they were not numbered among the other Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a special tribe in Israel.
Their registration counted 23,000 males.
Each male was at least one month old.
The Levites were not counted with the other Israelites.
God did not give the Levites any inheritance among the other Israelites.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה כִּ֣י׀ לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא־ נִתַּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest.
Moses and Eleazar counted the Israelites.
They counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab.
This place was by the Jordan River.
It was across from Jericho.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Among all these, however, there was not one who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron were leaders of Israel.
Moses and Aaron counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.
None of the people listed here were among those counted by Moses and Aaron in Sinai.
Not one man from the earlier census remained among these.
passages.original: וּבְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ לֹא־ הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

passages.text: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the Israelites.
The LORD said they would die in the wilderness.
None of them remained alive.
Only Caleb son of Jephunneh remained.
Only Joshua son of Nun remained.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם מ֥וֹת יָמֻ֖תוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְלֹא־ נוֹתַ֤ר מֵהֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֚י אִם־ כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃ס
